display_name: Local Ollama vision model (qwen2.5-vl 3b, VLM perception, GPU-safe)

metadata.model_choice: qwen2.5vl:3b chosen over 7b for GPU coexistence with the fullscreen game (2026-08-27). The 7b model (~5.6 GiB + vision projector ~1 GiB) plus the Electron game (RTX 5060 Ti, 16 GiB) does NOT fit in VRAM: it triggered repeated cudaMalloc OOM, llama-server crashes, and Ollama evict/reload loops that reset the GPU context under the fullscreen game -> monitor flicker + the Electron window losing its GPU surface (looked like the game minimizing). 3b (~3 GiB) fits alongside the game. Accuracy is lower on fanned 3D cards, but the VLM plausibility gate in perception (vlm_provider._board_rejection_reason) rejects degenerate/hallucinated boards and falls back to the heuristic, so a weaker model is safe. Switch back to 7b only with more VRAM (>=24 GiB) or by closing the game/other GPU apps during perception.
metadata.perf: 3b warm ~1.2-4s/call; 7b was 6-37s and crashed under OOM.
metadata.arch_note: llama3.2-vision (mllama) returns 500 on this Ollama build - do not use it.
